# Templates (English)

Keep the section order. No section longer than five bullets. Replace bracketed
placeholders; leave missing information as `[open: …]`.

---

## Decision variant

```markdown
# Management Summary: [Topic]

**As of:** [date] · **Author:** [name] · **Decision by:** [body] · **Decision needed by:** [date]

## Bottom line

[One or two sentences. What has to be decided, and what is recommended. Anyone who reads only this paragraph must not be misled.]

## Situation

- [Starting position, one sentence.]
- [Trigger: what changed, why now.]
- [Numbers with unit and time basis.]
- [Who is affected.]

## Options

| Option | Description | Effort / cost | Assessment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A: [name] | [One sentence.] | [Figure or `[open]`] | [One sentence.] |
| B: [name] | [One sentence.] | [Figure or `[open]`] | [One sentence.] |
| C: Do nothing | [What happens then.] | [Cost of inaction.] | [One sentence.] |

## Financial impact

- **One-off:** [amount or "none"]
- **Recurring:** [amount per year/month or "none"]
- **Funding source:** [budget line, reserve or `[open]`]

## Risks and side effects

- [Risk] — [impact], [mitigation].
- [Risk] — [impact], [mitigation].

## Recommendation

[Option X.] [One sentence of reasoning, tied back to the strongest point in Situation or Options.]

## Proposed resolution

> [Body] resolves to [action in infinitive, with amount, deadline and owner where known].

## Open points

- [Include only if there are any. Otherwise drop the section.]
```

---

## Overview variant

```markdown
# Management Summary: [Topic]

**As of:** [date] · **Author:** [name] · **Reporting period:** [period]

## Bottom line

[One or two sentences. The most important finding — not a description of what the report covers.]

## Background and mandate

- [Why this report exists, one or two bullets.]

## Key findings

- [Finding with figure and time basis.]
- [Finding with figure and time basis.]
- [Finding with figure and time basis.]

## Status

| Item | Status | Comment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Item] | [on track / watch / critical] | [One sentence.] |

## Next steps

| What | Who | By when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Step] | [Name] | [Date] |

## Action required from the body

[Either: "No action required, for information only." Or: name specifically what is needed — and then check whether the decision variant is the better fit after all.]
```
